{{Quote|Meanwhile, the Mandalorians were rapidly building warships at Breshig and Arda, utilizing vast caches of war matériel stolen during the Sith Wars from Foerost and Abhean.|Vilnau Tept, 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
'''Breshig''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. [[Homeworld/Legends|Home]] to the [[trill beast]] creatures, it became a part of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture. During the build-up to the [[Mandalorian Wars]] of [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]], Mandalorian [[Warship/Legends|warships]] were constructed at Breshig. The world's role in the Mandalorian history was eventually noted in [[Vilnau Teupt]]'s [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]] [[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul|keynote address]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Recently, a random spot check aboard the luxury liner ''Alamintari'', bound for the Outer Rim Territories, uncovered 10 kilos of rare Garcornian spice and a pre-recorded sound chip of a Breshig trill beast.|The fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
Breshig was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Breshig system/Legends|Breshig system]], a part of the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the creatures known as [[trill beast]]s.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==History==
{{Quote|Those worlds&mdash;along with the likes of Hrthging, Breshig, Shogun, and Ordo&mdash;became part of Mandalorian Space.|Vilnau Tept, 412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|<ref name="EGTW" />}}
[[File:Tskull_banner.svg|thumb|right|125px|The Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders (banner pictured) constructed warships at Breshig.]]
Breshig at one point came into contact with the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]], the warriors of a culture originating with the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and waging the [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] war-worship&ndash;based campaign known as the [[Mandalorian Crusades]] since [[7000 BBY]]. As a result, the world became one of the several to become part of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]-controlled [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Later, the members of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] movement constructed [[Warship/Legends|warships]] at Breshig and other sites during the build-up for their [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]] [[Mandalorian Wars|conflict]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'' noted a recent incident where a pre-recorded [[sound chip]] of a trill beast from Breshig was used to conceal the transportation of [[Garcornian spice]] in a [[T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Alamintari]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" /> [[Vilnau Teupt]] eventually mentioned Breshig and its involvement in the Mandalorian history in the keynote address "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]" at [[Brentaal Academy]]'s [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History|412th Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]] in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Breshig's name was first mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Breshig [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Breshig itself, in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] was the first to establish Breshig as a distinct world.<ref name="EGTW" />
